rubric.scale: 1-5 Likert Scale (1 = Poor, 2 = Weak, 3 = Acceptable, 4 = Good, 5 = Excellent)

dimensions.accuracy: Factual correctness and factual consistency of key intelligence claims.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Direct linking of report statements to verifiable citations (arXiv, CrossRef, Web).
dimensions.evidence_quality: Source reliability, peer-reviewed journal quality, and recency.
dimensions.strategic_usefulness: Actionability, clear opportunity/threat decomposition, and practical recommendations.
dimensions.uncertainty_handling: Honest qualification of missing data, non-speculative tone, and appropriate confidence badges.
dimensions.robustness: System stability under ambiguous prompts, tool outages, and adversarial claims.
dimensions.overall_quality: Overall synthesis clarity, formatting, and report value.
